tw-il-northbrook-tatge-1924.st: By Feb 1924 the estate had sold the stock and machinery and offered the 160-acre farm for rent; no clue to the killers and no recovery of the pail of greenbacks was reported through 1925.
src: Daily Herald (Des Plaines ed.), 22 Feb 1924, p. 5 (Newspapers.com 71502570)
